description: One CVE record from the NIST National Vulnerability Database: description, published and last-modified dates, NVD status, primary CVSS score and severity (v4.0, 3.1, 3.0 or 2.0, whichever NVD marks primary first), CWE weakness IDs and up to 5 reference URLs. It does not say whether the CVE is being exploited (use cisa-known-exploits or epss-exploit-score for that). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_cve_nvd_lookup
title: Security Cve Nvd Lookup
